sources.method: width = 25.4*D*a/sqrt(a^2+b^2), height = 25.4*D*b/sqrt(a^2+b^2), rounded half-up to 0.1 mm. D = 6.31 in, a:b = 2484:1116 taken exactly from resolution_px (square pixels assumed); the published diagonal is assumed exact (OEMs round it). notes: NAMING: sold under the same 'Find N3' name globally and in China; the only naming difference is the model code — CPH2499 on the global spec page, 入网型号 PHN110 (network-access model) on oppo.com/cn. Both are recorded in aliases. The hardware-identical OnePlus Open is NOT listed as an alias because no OPPO page states that relationship. TRAP (c) per-edition thickness and mass: OPPO publishes a Glass edition (11.7 mm folded, 245 g) and a Leather edition (11.9 mm folded, 239 g). Recorded values are the GLASS edition, which OPPO lists first on both the global and Chinese pages; note the Leather edition is 0.2 mm THICKER folded yet 6 g LIGHTER. TRAP-(b)-adjacent: the split thickness OPPO publishes is on the UNFOLDED state, not the folded one, and it is not a hinge-side measurement — it is the two halves of the opened device, 5.8 mm on one side and 5.9 mm on the other (Glass edition). Per the larger-value rule, open.depth records 5.9 mm; depth_at_hinge stays null because neither figure is a hinge-side value. The two halves are labelled differently in the two locales: the global English page says 'battery side'/'cover-screen side' while oppo.com/cn says 摄像头侧 (camera side)/外屏侧 (cover-screen side) — same numbers, conflicting label for the thinner half, so treat the side attribution as uncertain. Leather edition unfolded is 6.0 mm/5.9 mm. RESOLUTION MAPPING: the global page prints both resolutions on one unlabelled line, 'QXGA+(2440×2268)|FHD+(2484×1116)'. The Chinese spec page labels them explicitly — 内屏 (inner) 2440×2268, 外屏 (outer) 2484×1116 — and OPPO's own PPI figures on the global page corroborate it (2440×2268 over 7.82 in = 426 PPI, 2484×1116 over 6.31 in = 431 PPI, exactly OPPO's stated values), so the mapping is sourced, not inferred. CREASE: OPPO markets an 'industry-leading innovative hinge, crafted from aviation-grade materials' and TÜV crease certifications but never names a teardrop/water-drop or U profile, so hinge.crease is null. free_stop is true on OPPO's 自由悬停拍摄 (free-hover shooting) and the 'Multi-Angle FlexForm Camera'. MATERIALS: OPPO has no frame-material row on either spec page (the 'aviation-grade materials' and zirconium-alloy/aerospace-steel claims describe the hinge, and the carbon fibre is a screen support layer), so materials.frame is null; back is taken from OPPO's own edition names, 玻璃版 (glass) and 皮革版 (leather).
